scripts.build: pnpm --filter @srr/core-client build && pnpm --filter @srr/storage build && node scripts/build-wasm.mjs && node scripts/sync-renderer-wasm.mjs && pnpm --filter @srr/renderer build
scripts.test: cmake --preset native-debug && cmake --build --preset native-debug && ctest --preset native-debug --output-on-failure && pnpm --filter @srr/core-client test && pnpm --filter @srr/core-client typecheck && pnpm --filter @srr/storage test && pnpm --filter @srr/storage typecheck && pnpm --filter @srr/renderer test && pnpm --filter @srr/renderer typecheck && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
